No otherwise viable option is downgraded because it favors an academic-faculty-only trajectory.

The plan specifies academic research, university-based summer research, applications, and financial comparison, but no executable step specifically implements preservation of industry-research or employability options.
The report provides general preparation targets and timelines, but no threshold, allocation, sequencing rule, or checkpoint for preserving industry or employment optionality.
No concrete condition is stated under which an exclusively academic-faculty trajectory would become preferable.
Employment-related evidence is not explicitly connected to an optionality priority and then to a downstream selection or action. Establishing that chain would require inference.
